notes: Buildings of the Village district, one entry per roof part. Outlines: wall lines fitted to the 2017 LiDAR roof-edge returns (midway between the outermost roof return and the nearest ground return beyond it, but no more than 0.4 m past the roof return: the tall walls hide the ground at their foot from the scanner, which pushed the plain midpoint 1 m out on the 5 and 6 storey walls), each building at its own axis angle (fitted to its long walls), corners exact right angles; OSM footprints used only as a start. Heights NAVD88 from the LiDAR: flat tops are the roof deck median plus the 0.2 m rim seen at the edge; hip parts give ridge (99.5th percentile, parts above excluded) and eave (returns 0.2 to 1.2 m inside the edge). Hawk Crossings (Falco, Accipiter, Buteo): flat-roofed garden apartments stepped in plan, each building split where its roof steps down (about 0.9 to 1.6 m); Buteo's low south end block is its own part. The Village halls (Williams, Fenwick, Count Basie, Paul) share one design: two 20.4 x 32 m hipped wings joined by a link round an open courtyard; the link is a flat white roof at both ends, a smaller hip in the middle and a raised hipped block (tower) over half of it; 3 m rooftop boxes over 20 m2 on the flat link roofs are parts with base. Sinatra Hall: two hipped wings and a middle block (flat white roof to the west, a raised hipped block with a small peak to the east). Abbott and Costello Center: one hip with a higher hipped block on its south-east side. Ground round each building (2nd-98th percentile of ground returns 1-3 m outside): Hawk Crossings Falco 126.4..128.5 m; Hawk Crossings Accipiter 123.5..126.4 m; Hawk Crossings Buteo 122.2..124.2 m; Fenwick Hall 113.0..116.4 m; Williams Hall 108.7..114.6 m; Paul Hall 105.7..111.3 m; Count Basie Hall 104.9..106.6 m; Francis A. Sinatra Hall 113.3..118.2 m; Abbott and Costello Center 107.4..112.8 m; kiosk (OSM 233913142) 104.3..105.0 m. Not modelled: no pool house by the pool (the LiDAR shows nothing over 2 m there but trees and fences); the 'small building' at x -123..-101, y 1113..1131 in the footprint notes is an OSM road (way 313032738), no building there; the solar canopies of Lot 61 belong to another zone. Facade colours, window sizes and some floor counts are guesses unless a source is cited.
